items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I heard Ray Nance when Earl Hines came out here to Los Angeles before I ever left here. He and Trummy Young was with the Band.

ctx.x: Before he worked at the Club Deluxe, is that right?

Yeah, I heard Ray Nance when Earl Hines came out here to Los Angeles before I ever left here. He and Trummy Young was with the Band. And they were featured instrumentalist and singers with the band at that time.
So the next time after that that you saw Ray Nance was when you were working at the Club Deluxe?
